messages:
Maya: Quick flag - after the route-resolver v2 canary went live (5%), some tenants report invoice-preview showing higher per-token cost. Console: Atelier shows 'premium' pricing applied although tenant plan is 'standard'.
Liam: I can reproduce. Looks like resolver v2 returns `route_alias` earlier in the pipeline; enrichment picks price by alias before tenant override. Old behavior preferred tenant-level plan.
Priya: ops-bot: canary started at 1715099800 (route-resolver:v2 -> 5%).
ops-bot: Canary id=cr-2026-03-22-003 started.
billing-bot: sample event: {tenant: "atelier", tokens: 540, route_alias: "creative-v2", route_id: "r-legacy-17", resolved_price: "premium-embed", tenant_plan: "standard"} -> preview shows premium applied.
Maya: UX request: add a "Projected charge delta" widget to the rollout page showing estimated net change if current canary mapping is accepted. Help PMs decide to continue.
Liam: short-term mitigation: revert alias-first lookup in enrichment. I'll push a tiny config flip to prefer tenant_plan when present. PR ready.
Priya: add telemetry: metering.route.price_mismatch_rate per-tenant. Alert: >0.5% over 15m -> notify, >2% -> auto-pause canary. We should gate ramps on that metric.
Maya: also please add console line item for "Unattributed/Conflicting price" so totals don't silently hide mapping issues. Toggleable for auditors.
Liam: will add hotfix to canary and include a dry-run backfill that computes diffs for last 2h. Dry-run output posted to S3 for review.
Priya: owners: hotfix=Liam, console widget=Maya, alerts/ops=Priya. Pausing further ramps until we validate backfill diffs.
ops-bot: Canary paused for route-resolver:v2 (cr-2026-03-22-003) - hold reason: price_mismatch_rate exceeded threshold.
Maya: filing rollout checklist update: "billing projection card + mismatch metric present" required before >10% ramp.
Liam: noted. I'll attach PR + staging link in this thread once patch is live.
Maya: thanks team, closing thread for now; reopen if diffs show unexpected reclassification.
